name: Urbanica (palo) Retail Ltd.
summary: Urbanica (Palo) Retail Ltd engages in the designing, purchasing, marketing, and retail sale of clothing for women, men, and children in Israel. The company offers home wear products and fashion accessories. It operates stores, as well as online websites under the Urbanika brand. The company was incorporated in 2014 and is based in Rosh Haayin, Israel. Urbanica (Palo) Retail Ltd operates as a subsidiary of Castro Model Ltd.
